dtf-ai-flow.title: From AI artwork to layout and MainTop
dtf-ai-flow.summary: Prepare the artwork, build a DTF layout, generate the white-ink channel and continue automatically into MainTop. One connected path to production.
steps: Finish the artwork in the AI Workbench and open the repeated-layout tool.
Choose proportional or independent sizing, then set the dimensions and arrangement for the order.
Generate the layout and check quantity, spacing and complete artwork in Photoshop.
Generate the white-ink channel and production files, then continue automatically into MainTop.

dtf-single.title: One artwork, straight into MainTop
dtf-single.summary: Set the finished size, prepare white ink and output the file. A complete workflow, even for a single image.
steps: Open the artwork in Photoshop and choose DTF Single Artwork.
Review dimensions, resolution, white-ink choke and margins.
Enable automatic MainTop integration and start processing.
Check the result, the MainTop job and the output folder.

dtf-count.title: Arrange the quantity your order needs
dtf-count.summary: Repeat one design by quantity, generate white ink and continue into MainTop. Ideal for orders with multiple copies of the same artwork.
steps: Open Repeated Layout and choose the quantity-based mode.
Enter the required quantity, artwork size, layout width and spacing.
Generate the layout and check the count and edges in Photoshop.
Create the white-ink channel, export the file and continue into MainTop.

dtf-stretch.title: Set width and height independently
dtf-stretch.summary: When the order calls for exact dimensions in both directions, set width and height separately and check the resulting proportions.
steps: Turn off proportional sizing in Single Artwork and enter the target width and height.
Check the shape, then review resolution, choke and margins.
Generate the artwork and verify both artwork and canvas dimensions.
Complete white ink and file output, then continue automatically into MainTop.

dtf-nesting.title: Nest different shapes with rotation
dtf-nesting.summary: Combine multiple outlines on one layout. Rotation and close nesting help make better use of the available space.
steps: Place the artwork in an input folder and choose Multiple-image Layout.
Review layout width, spacing and allowed rotation.
Generate the layout and inspect how the outlines fit together.
Check edges, spacing and overall dimensions, then generate channels and continue into MainTop.

dtf-canvas.title: Custom canvas to layout and MainTop
dtf-canvas.summary: Prepare artwork to a defined canvas, arrange multiple images and generate production files before continuing into MainTop.
steps: Select the artwork folder and configure custom-canvas cropping.
Check dimensions and processing settings, then prepare the images.
Generate the layout and inspect count, rotation and nesting in Photoshop.
Create the channels and export TIFF, then continue automatically into MainTop.

dtf-ai-layout.title: Turn AI artwork into a complete DTF layout
dtf-ai-layout.summary: Continue from the AI Workbench into layout, white ink and MainTop without having to find a separate workflow for every step.
steps: Review the finished artwork in the AI Workbench.
Open DTF layout and choose an arrangement suited to the order.
Check the layout, then generate white ink and production files.
Continue automatically into MainTop to complete prepress preparation.

dtg-ai-new.title: AI artwork to DTG and MainTop
dtg-ai-new.summary: Continue from the AI Workbench into DTG, choose the fabric and white-ink settings, then automatically pass the finished artwork to MainTop.
steps: Prepare artwork in the AI Workbench and continue into DTG.
Choose the fabric workflow and review size and white-ink settings.
Enable automatic MainTop integration and start processing.
Check MainTop progress, the output and the corresponding print job.

dtg-ai.title: A connected DTG workflow
dtg-ai.summary: Image preparation, fabric selection, channel generation and MainTop processing follow one continuous path.
steps: After preparing the artwork, open the DTG workspace.
Review fabric type, dimensions, white-ink amounts and margins.
Start processing to generate the production file.
Continue into MainTop and inspect the job and output.

sublimation-pdf.title: PDF pattern layout, from roll width to cut lines
sublimation-pdf.summary: Choose your paper width and let the pieces nest. Add cutting lines in a color you choose, compare layouts and export the result.
steps: Import the PDF and check the pages and pattern pieces.
Set the roll width, such as 1820 mm, then review piece spacing and roll splitting.
Add cutting lines as needed and choose a clearly visible color.
Generate and compare layouts, then inspect the pieces, cutting lines and output file.

halftone.title: Automated halftone processing
halftone.summary: Load artwork, refine the dot pattern and compare the result before continuing to production.
steps: Import the artwork you want to process.
Choose the mode and adjust dimensions, dots and tone.
Compare the result and inspect detail and edges.
Save the result or continue into the next production tool.

maintop-setup.title: Set up automatic MainTop integration
maintop-setup.summary: Open the settings beside automatic MainTop integration. Review the detected program, output folder and ICC configuration for a smooth DTF or DTG workflow.
steps: Open the settings beside automatic MainTop integration in a production module.
Review the detected MainTop program and related paths.
Confirm the output folder and ICC configuration, adjusting them for production.
Return to DTF or DTG, enable integration and check a complete job.
